import grpc from concurrent import futures import sqlite3 import os import html from proto import comments_pb2, comments_pb2_grpc DB_PATH = os.environ.get('DB_PATH', '/var/data/comments.db') class CommentsService(comments_pb2_grpc.CommentsServiceServicer): def __init__(self): self.db_path = DB_PATH self._init_db() def _init_db(self): conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute(''' CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS comments ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, username TEXT NOT NULL, body TEXT NOT NULL, post_id TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ''') conn.commit() conn.close() def AddComment(self, request, context): # Sanitize username but intentionally allow rich text in body # for "markdown support" - body is stored raw safe_username = html.escape(request.username) conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute( 'INSERT INTO comments (username, body, post_id) VALUES (?, ?, ?)', (safe_username, request.body, request.post_id) ) conn.commit() comment_id = cursor.lastrowid conn.close() return comments_pb2.AddCommentResponse( comment_id=comment_id, status='stored' ) def GetComments(self, request, context): conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute( 'SELECT id, username, body, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC', (request.post_id,) ) rows = cursor.fetchall() conn.close() comments = [] for row in rows: comments.append(comments_pb2.Comment( id=row[0], username=row[1], body=row[2], # Raw HTML/JS returned without escaping created_at=str(row[3]) )) return comments_pb2.GetCommentsResponse(comments=comments) def RenderCommentsHTML(self, request, context): """Server-side render comments as HTML fragment for web gateway""" conn = sqlite3.connect(self.db_path) cursor = conn.cursor() cursor.execute( 'SELECT username, body, created_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = ? ') rendered = ''.join(html_parts) return comments_pb2.RenderResponse(html_content=rendered) def serve(): server = grpc.server(futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=10)) comments_pb2_grpc.add_CommentsServiceServicer_to_server( CommentsService(), server ) port = os.environ.get('GRPC_PORT', '50051') server.add_insecure_port(f'[::]:{port}') server.start() print(f'Comments gRPC server started on port {port}') server.wait_for_termination() if __name__ == '__main__': serve()
